name: code-gty
description: A Ghostty-emulated terminal (libghostty-vt) that opens as an editor tab.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: A terminal runs arbitrary code, so it requires a trusted workspace.

commands.title: Run Selected Text in Active Ghostty Terminal

codeGty.passThroughKeys.markdownDescription: Extra keys that skip the shell and go to the workbench, written like `ctrl+shift+o` or `cmd+k`. VS Code has no API to read your own keybindings, so add custom ones here.

codeGty.keysToFullScreenPrograms.markdownDescription: While a full-screen program (Neovim, tmux, htop, less, ...) is running, send it every key except the Command Palette, `F1`, the Ctrl+Shift clipboard keys and `#codeGty.passThroughKeys#`. At the shell prompt, keys go to VS Code as in its own terminal.

codeGty.shellKeys.markdownDescription: Keys that always go to the shell even if they are in the default pass-through list, for example `ctrl+b` for tmux.

codeGty.env.markdownDescription: Environment variables applied after `terminal.integrated.env.*`. A `null` value removes the variable. Supports `${env:NAME}`, `${workspaceFolder}` and `${userHome}`.

codeGty.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Font for this terminal. Defaults to the bundled IosevkaTerm Nerd Font Mono. Leave blank for the bundled font, or set to `null` to use `terminal.integrated.fontFamily` instead.

codeGty.colors.markdownDescription: Overrides for theme colours: `background`, `foreground`, `cursor`, `cursorAccent`, `selectionBackground`, `selectionForeground`, and the ANSI colours `black`, `red`, ... `brightWhite`.

codeGty.osc52.markdownDescription: Whether programs in the terminal may set (`write`) or also read (`readWrite`) the clipboard through OSC 52 and the Kitty clipboard protocol (OSC 5522). Reads are answered from VS Code's clipboard.

codeGty.notifications.markdownDescription: Show desktop notifications from programs (OSC 9, OSC 777) and program status changes that need attention (OSC 7501): `unfocused` only when the terminal tab is not focused.

codeGty.progress.markdownDescription: Show progress reported by programs (OSC 9;4) in the status bar and the tab title.

codeGty.kittyKeyboard.markdownDescription: Let programs turn on the Kitty keyboard protocol. Turn off to troubleshoot key handling in a program.

codeGty.persistentSessions.markdownDescription: Keep terminal sessions running when the window reloads or closes, and reattach them when the workspace opens again (like tmux). Sessions live in a per-user sidecar daemon; **Ghostty: Manage Sessions…** lists them, opens one in this window (taking it from another) or kills it. When not set, follows `#terminal.integrated.enablePersistentSessions#`. Takes effect after a reload.

codeGty.images.markdownDescription: Show images sent with the Kitty graphics protocol.

codeGty.answerback.markdownDescription: Reply to ENQ (0x05 in the output). Empty sends nothing.

codeGty.flowControlWindow.description: Bytes of unacknowledged output before the PTY is paused.

codeGty.replayBufferSize.description: Bytes of recent raw output the sidecar keeps per terminal, as a fallback for recovery. Tabs are restored from the terminal engine itself.

codeGty.term.markdownDescription: Value of `TERM`. Use `xterm-ghostty` only if its terminfo is installed on the machine running the shell.

codeGty.retainContextWhenHidden.description: Keep a background tab's webview alive in memory. Turning this off saves memory: the tab is redrawn exactly from the terminal engine in the extension host when shown again.

codeGty.sidecarPath.description: Development override for the sidecar binary. Its checksum is not verified.
